title: run.yipyap.reply.alert.remediation_result.v1
description: Record the outcome of an automated remediation attempt. When outcome=success and the monitor has recovered, auto-resolves the alert.

remediation_id.description: ID from the matching remediation_started reply. Used to correlate and close the remediation record.

outcome.description: Result class. "success" may trigger auto-resolve if the monitor has recovered; "failure" logs and re-enables notify; "partial" logs without state change.

message.description: Human-readable outcome summary (e.g. "restart succeeded, pod is Ready, monitor last check UP").

artifact_url.description: Optional link to a remediation run log, script output, or dashboard.
